title: Durable Objects and D1 – Increased Errors
summary: Cloudflare is investigating an increased level of errors and latency affecting a subset of Durable Objects and D1 customers. Affected customers may see storage operations fail or take longer than usual to complete. Workers that don't use Durable Objects or D1 are not affected. We are working to analyse and mitigate this problem. More updates to follow shortly.
